label: opus-isolated-five-d-pilot-01
rationale: Calibrate the exact isolated 5D scope on fresh questions, balancing all 10 classical lakaras and root classes. Earlier composition scores included prefixes or explicit pada and do not validate this scope. Half the pilot tests defensible nested intensive recipes; the rest supplies simpler recipe anchors.

adapter_needs.status: integrated and all 120 tasks pass shared full validator
adapter_needs.answer_format: one Devanagari form in answer tags; accept any audited gold variant

review_before_submit: Verify all artifact hashes against the request.
Reserve worst-case cost under the shared lock and existing cumulative provider cap.

pairing_recommendation.condition: After Opus pilot completion and grammatical disagreement review, if the mixture or its recipe groups provide useful calibration evidence under the shared budget. No worker submission is authorized.

analysis_plan: Report total requests, completed valid outputs, grammatical correctness, refusals, truncations, invalid outputs and infrastructure failures separately.
Report fixed recipe and lakara / voice cells, including sample counts; do not select final questions by these questions’ own errors.
Investigate repeated oracle disagreements before interpreting low accuracy as difficulty.
Use a fresh development panel for changed recipe weights; freeze final sampling before held-out evaluation.
limitations: No measured isolated-5D reference accuracy yet.
Mechanical regeneration and eight source controls do not certify every rare-root variant.
120 tasks are a pilot, below the minimum benchmark size and precision target.
spending_authority: Coordinator only; worker made no paid calls and did not modify the shared ledger. Planning envelopes are not separate budget authority.
